item.title: Klibs.io Grows to 4,200+ KMP Projects With Smarter Discovery and New AI Integrations
item.summary: Explore a growing Kotlin Multiplatform catalog in your browser, or bring up-to-date library data directly into your AI development workflow through the klibs.io MCP server. When we introduced klibs.io in December 2024, the goal was simple: make it easier to find a Kotlin Multiplatform library that fits both your use case and target platforms. Since […]
